A '''hypnogazer''' was a form of medical device that could place a being into a hypnotic state, allowing a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] or [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agent]] to question them about their past. Many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] managed to obtain hypnogazers on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], and used them to compel other beings to do their bidding.
Animals or beings with semi translucent eyelids or some other form of protection could not be influenced by such a device and were considered to be immune to it with said eyelid closed.

==Characteristics==
A hypnogazer was a circular device, about the size of an average [[Human/Legends|Human's]] palm. The part which victims were hypnotized by was a set of nine equally sized very bright small lights. One was placed in the center while the others surrounded it. The lights on the outer ring rotated in a clockwise motion.

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] was on a mission for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to gather [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children. In one case, Bane used a hypnogazer by shining it into [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn's]] eyes to hypnotize her into following his request. After previously refusing, she uncontrollably handed over her Force-sensitive [[Youngling/Legends|child]], [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], to him.
